caption: The drawing depicts a manual coffee grinder composed of a square wooden base with visible grain and texture in various shades of brown, suggesting an aged or weathered appearance. The box has a small metal latch in the center of its front face, and the upper section is fitted with an iron or metal grinding mechanism, consisting of a bowl-shaped hopper in the center, a vertical handle attachment, and a long, curved crank that extends horizontally to the right, ending in a rounded knob. The metal parts are rendered in darker brown and gray shades, giving a rusty or oxidized look. Mounted on the surface next to the hopper, there are smaller metal pieces, possibly for adjusting the grinder mechanism. There is an open compartment at the lower front of the wooden box, revealing the inner space where ground coffee would be collected. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, free of additional objects or decorations. In the lower left corner, the name “ORRIE MCCOMBS” is written in small, uppercase letters.
title: Coffee Grinder
